CAMPAIGN_NAME: CAGE22-1 Expedition Repparfjord Environmental Geochemistry Study
ORGANISATION: UiT The Arctic University of Norway
CAMPAIGN_COMMENT: Multidisciplinary research expedition using RV Helmer Hanssen to examine metal stability and past/current status of foraminiferal community in Repparfjord, Northern Norway. Study coupled pore water chemistry analysis with foraminiferal analysis from sediment cores. Copper concentration data reported for sediment core porewater in SI 2.
